## 📋 Description / 变更描述

Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed / 请简要说明本次变更内容及修复的 Issue。

Fixes #(issue_number)

## 🧪 Type of Change / 变更类型

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue) / 缺陷修复
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality) / 新增功能
- [ ] 📖 Documentation update / 文档更新
- [ ] ⚡ Performance optimization or refactor / 性能优化或重构
- [ ] 🧪 Test suite enhancement / 测试用例补充

## ✅ Checklist / 自检清单

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project (`ruff` / `black` / `flake8`) / 代码符合项目风格规范
- [ ] I have run `pytest` and all 192 tests pass / 已运行 pytest 且 192 项测试全部通过
- [ ] I have updated the relevant documentation (English & Chinese) / 已同步更新中英双语文档
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes / 本地测试全部通过
